title: 1882 Lofts - 301 - Downtown 2nd & Church
description:
Parking not included.  Prime downtown location on 2nd & Church.

Built in 1882 by the George A. Dickel Company.

Short walk to the Stadium, Lower Broadway & Printer’s Alley.

Curated Outlaw Country record collection.

Units 301 & 302 are the only lofts on the 3rd floor.  Both are 2 king bedroom/2 bath, so if you have a larger group you can rent both and have the whole floor.   (2 lofts on 4th floor also available)

Please check out our other building 3 blocks away, The Armstrong Corset Lofts.
